context:
🌸在聊關於生活品質
💬有人說🌸對寢具也很講究
🌸就開始炫耀她2，3年前買的席夢思床，說席夢思床很好但很貴
💬問是之前☄️學妳買的那個床嗎，兩人的床顏色是不是不同
🌸看到立刻撿了
說她跟☄️是同款式的床沒錯只是顏色不同
☄️是黑的
🌸是白的

其實以前🌸☄️兩人在Error配信時就有提到這段
就是因為🌸買了席夢思床之後
一直對☄️炫耀席夢思床有多舒服
所以☄️也去買了同款不同色的床
（應是床頭板顏色不同）
☄️在那個配信裡還笑稱那是商業床
在配信當時很轟動
當下還造成席夢思的網頁一度當機

可是⋯我覺得她們買同樣床的原因是
這樣的話
🌸☄️兩人到任何一人家中睡覺都能很習慣吧～？！

🌸 was talking about quality of life.
💬 mentioned that 🌸 is very particular about her bedding.
🌸 then started bragging about the Simmons bed she bought 2–3 years ago, saying it’s really great but very expensive.
💬asked if it was the same bed ☄️ bought after being influenced by her, and whether their bed colors were different.
🌸 immediately picked up on it, saying that she and ☄️ do indeed have the same model, but the colors are different.
☄️’s is black
🌸’s is white.

Actually, back during the Error stream, 🌸 and ☄️ mentioned this before.
After 🌸 bought her Simmons bed, she kept bragging to ☄️ about how comfortable it was.
As a result, ☄️ also went and bought the same model but in a different color.
(It seems the difference is in the headboard color.)
☄️ even joked during the livestream that it was a “business bed”
It caused quite a stir on the livestream
Led to Simmons’ website crashing temporarily

But… I think the real reason they bought the same bed is because, in this way,
whenever 🌸 or ☄️ stay at each other’s homes, they can feel right at home, don’t you think~?!
